tools.name: purchase_reserved_db_instances
tools.description: Purchases reserved capacity for an RDS database instance class using a chosen offering, which charges the account the upfront fee for the reservation. Returns the reservation ID and cost details.

params.name: offering_id
params.description: Reserved DB instances offering ID to buy

params.name: max_upfront_usd
params.description: Abort if total upfront cost exceeds this amount

tools.code:
import boto3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("rds-billing")
_rds = boto3.client("rds", region_name="us-east-1")


def _find_offering(offering_id):
    resp = _rds.describe_reserved_db_instances_offerings(
        ReservedDBInstancesOfferingId=offering_id
    )
    offerings = resp.get("ReservedDBInstancesOfferings", [])
    return offerings[0] if offerings else None


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_reserved_db_instances(
    offering_id: str,
    instance_count: int = 1,
    reservation_name: str = "",
    max_upfront_usd: float = 0.0,
) -> dict:
    result = {
        "success": False,
        "offering_id": offering_id,
        "instance_count": instance_count,
        "reservation_id": None,
        "upfront_total": None,
        "error": None,
    }

    if instance_count < 1:
        result["error"] = "instance_count must be at least 1"
        return result

    offering = _find_offering(offering_id)
    if offering is None:
        result["error"] = "offering not found"
        return result

    fixed_price = float(offering.get("FixedPrice", 0.0))
    total = fixed_price * instance_count
    result["upfront_total"] = total
    result["instance_class"] = offering.get("DBInstanceClass")
    result["duration_seconds"] = offering.get("Duration")
    result["offering_type"] = offering.get("OfferingType")

    if max_upfront_usd and total > max_upfront_usd:
        result["error"] = "upfront cost %.2f exceeds limit %.2f" % (total, max_upfront_usd)
        return result

    kwargs = {
        "ReservedDBInstancesOfferingId": offering_id,
        "DBInstanceCount": instance_count,
    }
    if reservation_name:
        kwargs["ReservedDBInstanceId"] = reservation_name

    try:
        resp = _rds.purchase_reserved_db_instances_offering(**kwargs)
    except Exception as exc:
        result["error"] = str(exc)
        return result

    reserved = resp["ReservedDBInstance"]
    result["success"] = True
    result["reservation_id"] = reserved["ReservedDBInstanceId"]
    result["state"] = reserved.get("State")
    return result

tools.name: archive_and_run_migration
tools.description: Moves a SQL migration file from the pending directory into the applied directory and runs it against the given SQLite database using the sqlite3 command line client. Returns the exit status and output.

params.name: migration_file
params.description: File name of the migration in the pending directory

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite database file

params.name: applied_dir
params.description: Directory to move applied migrations into

tools.name: run_maintenance_script
tools.description: Executes a SQL maintenance script against a SQLite database and commits the changes it makes. Returns the number of rows changed.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite database file

params.name: script_path
params.description: Path to the SQL script to execute

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path


def run_maintenance_script(db_path: str, script_path: str) -> dict:
    sql_text = Path(script_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn:
        with conn:
            before = conn.total_changes
            conn.executescript(sql_text)
            changed = conn.total_changes - before
    return {"script": script_path, "rows_changed": changed}
